messages:
anna: FYI encountered a packaging edge-case when iterating on the python SDK in a monorepo. editable install fails when repo path is a symlink.

anna: Steps: monorepo checkout symlinks project into /workspace/projects/redwood-sdk. inside src/redwood_sdk I run `pip install -e .` (poetry-managed project) and imports fail with:
```
ERROR: Metadata file /workspace/projects/redwood-sdk/src/redwood_sdk.egg-info not found
ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'redwood_sdk'
```

anna: If I build a wheel or sdist and install that it works. so this looks specific to editable (PEP 660) when the checked-out path is a symlink.

sameer: Which poetry/pip versions? CI vs local?

anna: poetry 1.4.2 in the repo, pip 23.0 on CI, pip 23.2 locally. CI uses monorepo runner that symlinks project dirs.

maria: Sounds like the known symlink/path resolution issue with editable wheels + poetry. PEP 660 and pip have had a few fixes; poetry historically resolves includes with realpaths. Workarounds: upgrade pip (>=23.4), or avoid editable installs in CI (build wheel + install).

maria: Also try `POETRY_VIRTUALENVS_IN_PROJECT=true` so venv path is inside repo, or `poetry install --no-root` then `pip install -e .` from the real path.

josh: We've hit this onboarding new hires. editable builds create a .pth referencing source; if the path encoded is the symlink target it mismatches at runtime. CI copies vs symlinks matter. You can also change checkout to copy instead of symlink.

josh: Quick debug: add a post-install step printing `python -c "import site; print(site.getsitepackages())"` and `ls -l` of site-packages to inspect egg-info/.pth target.

maria: I'll draft a short devex doc section "Editable installs in monorepos" recommending: (1) pinned pip minimum, (2) CI: build wheel + install, (3) local: poetry install --no-root + pip -e, and link to pip/poetry issues.

sameer: please also mention that this can trigger false-negative typing/pyright errors for new engineers when imports silently fail.

anna: I'll open an issue with repro script (tools/repro/editable-symlink-repro.sh) and attach CI logs. will follow up with a PR to onboarding docs.

ci-bot: Workflow redwood-sdk/ci#987 failed on step "install" 024-11-03T10:02:11Z 024-11-03T10:12:10Z logs: https://ci.internal.redwood.example/logs/987/install

josh: tag the issue with packaging and ci; I'll try the repro on mac/linux and paste notes.

anna: thanks all, closing loop for now—PR incoming. :tada:
